sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash-Sante official model card
sources.evidence: Exact Sante card identifies a healthcare specialization of Ling-3.0-flash; publishes nominal 124B total and 5.1B active per token, MIT license, downloadable weights, hybrid KDA/gated-MLA sparse MoE, 256K training context, default thinking and tool use.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash-Sante checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM/bailing_hybrid: 42 main layers, group size 6, first 2 dense FFNs, 512 routed experts with 8 selected, one shared expert, hidden width 2560, one next-token prediction layer, 262144 positions, BF16, untied word embeddings; no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash-Sante implementation
sources.evidence: Decoder uses KDA except every sixth layer using gated MLA: 35 KDA and 7 MLA main layers. Layer 42 is BailingMoeV3MTPLayer. expert_bias is registered as a non-parameter buffer; A_log and dt_bias are learned nn.Parameters. MTP reuses input embeddings and lm_head; the two matrices are separate with tie_word_embeddings=false.

sources.title: Exact Sante checkpoint: bounded safetensors header inventory
sources.evidence: Fetched only the eight-byte length and JSON header from each of model-00001-of-00027.safetensors through model-00027-of-00027.safetensors using HTTP 206 byte ranges. All 63783 indexed names match. Raw 127486405600 elements minus 20992 expert_bias buffer elements gives 127486384608 learned parameters: 124414191072 main plus 3072193536 MTP. BF16=127486240128 elements; F32=165472 (20992 buffers and 144480 learned KDA A_log/dt_bias). No packed quantization, scale tensors, duplicate offsets, or serialized tied aliases. No full weights were downloaded.

sources.title: Sante checkpoint shard index
sources.evidence: Maps 63783 tensor names to 27 shards, including layer 42 MTP, one input-embedding matrix and one output-head matrix. Its total_size metadata is 254978385024 bytes; shape/offset-validated headers sum to 254973142144 tensor-data bytes, so parameter counts use actual tensor shapes rather than dividing this metadata size.

name.note: Display normalization of the exact official Ling-3.0-flash-Sante name; distinct from Flash, Fin and VL.

developer.note: Published by inclusionAI and announced by its Ant Ling account; retain catalog display capitalization.

family.note: Explicitly built on Ling-3.0-flash; normalized Ling family key.

release_date.note: Original dated Ant Ling introduction and contemporaneous Vercel availability establish September 4. Novita says catalog addition September 3, which does not establish earlier public service. The October Hugging Face repository/weight publication is later and must not replace the original API release date.

open_weights.note: Exact Sante public weights are accessible as 27 shards; baseline false is stale.

license.note: Exact Sante model-card YAML license is mit; not transferred from a sibling.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned checkpoint count in decimal billions: 127486405600 header elements minus 41 x 512 nonlearned expert_bias buffers. Main model is 124.414191072B, consistent with the nominal 124B card label; auxiliary layer-42 MTP adds 3.072193536B. Includes distinct input embeddings and output head once each. BF16/F32 tensors are unpacked, and learned KDA A_log/dt_bias remain included.

active_parameters_b.note: Exact Sante card explicitly reports 5.1B active parameters per token, retained as a nominal developer figure. Config verifies 8 of 512 routed experts plus one shared expert per MoE layer. The card does not precisely define embedding, output-head or MTP inclusion in its active-count convention; no exact phase-specific active count is inferred.

architecture.note: Hybrid linear-attention MoE: 42 main layers with 35 Kimi Delta Attention and 7 gated multi-head latent attention layers in a 5:1 pattern; two initial dense FFNs followed by 40 MoE layers, each with 512 routed experts, top-8 routing and one shared expert. One additional gated-MLA MoE MTP layer is auxiliary.

context_window.note: Exact config max_position_embeddings=262144, model card 256K and serving example 262144; no larger sibling context transferred.

modalities.note: Text-only causal language model and exact provider text-to-text endpoint; no vision module or image-input claim.

reasoning.note: Native thinking enabled by default and switchable per request in the exact chat template.

tool_call.note: Exact card and template explicitly support tool calls, with ling3 parser serving examples.

description.value: Health and medicine specialization of Ling 3.0 Flash for medical reasoning and evidence-based retrieval
description.note: Supported as intended healthcare reasoning and evidence-retrieval use; no clinical-accuracy or certification claim.

patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 127.486384608B learned parameters = 124.414191072B main model + 3.072193536B auxiliary MTP. The official 124B label rounds the main model; 5.1B active per token is the nominal developer figure, whose precise embedding, output-head and MTP inclusion convention is not specified. Header raw inventory includes 20,992 nonlearned expert_bias buffer elements, which are excluded. Main input embeddings and output head are untied; MTP reuses them. Hybrid MoE combines 35 KDA and 7 gated MLA main layers; two initial dense FFNs, then 40 layers selecting 8 of 512 routed experts plus one shared expert. Original API launch September 4, 2026 predates the October public-weight repository; Novita separately records a September 3 catalog addition.
